title: Pawn Takes Knight
setup: A black knight has wandered close to your e-pawn. Your pawn can win it, if you remember which way a pawn captures.
hint: Pawns capture one square diagonally forward. Which two squares does the e4-pawn attack?
explanation:
## The Idea

A pawn moves straight but **captures diagonally**, and the knight on d5 is standing on one of the two squares your pawn on e4 attacks.

{{exd5}} and the pawn takes a whole knight. Nothing guards d5, so nothing takes back: the knight is simply yours.

Every pawn guards the two squares diagonally in front of it. Anything that steps onto them can be taken.
